name: Account transactions filtered by month and account type
description:
Verify that the API correctly returns transactions filtered by a specific month for a given type account.

Expected results:
- Response status is 200 (OK)
- Response content type is XML
- At least one transaction is returned
- Each transaction:
  - has a numeric ID
  - belongs to the requested account
  - has a valid numeric amount
  - matches the requested month
  - contains a non-empty description
  - matches the requested account type                    
- All transaction IDs are unique

labels.name: story
labels.value: Filter transactions by month and account type
